who_are_you.speaker: THE WOMAN
who_are_you.text: Someone who has waited at this gate longer than you remember being dead.

choices.text: Then tell me why you waited.

met_before.speaker: THE WOMAN
met_before.text: Not in a way you would believe yet. You always recognize me before you recognize yourself.

choices.text: What do you mean by always?

what_happened.speaker: THE WOMAN
what_happened.text: You ran out of time. The cemetery only gave you enough back to ask the wrong questions.

why_wait.speaker: THE WOMAN
why_wait.text: Because every road out of here begins with you deciding to follow me.

choices.text: This time, I choose where we go.

not_answered.speaker: THE WOMAN
not_answered.text: Good. You are asking sharper questions than last time.

choices.text: There it is again. Last time.
I won't follow someone who lies to me.

always.speaker: THE WOMAN
always.text: Some memories return as places. Some return as people. Yours keeps returning as me.

choices.text: Then show me what I forgot.
I think you're the reason I forgot.

dead_answer.speaker: THE WOMAN
dead_answer.text: Dead is only the first thing you are now.

choices.text: I want the truth, not poetry.

follow.speaker: THE WOMAN
follow.text: Then stay close. The next memory moves faster than you do.

distrust.speaker: THE WOMAN
distrust.text: You never do. You follow anyway because the road already knows your footsteps.

defiant_end.speaker: THE WOMAN
defiant_end.text: Maybe this is the version of you that finally makes it to the end awake.

confrontation.speaker: THE WOMAN
confrontation.text: You were not supposed to read those.

choices.text: How many times have you done this?

how_many.speaker: THE WOMAN
how_many.text: Enough that I stopped counting faces and started counting songs.

choices.text: Every skeleton in this room was me.

why_me.speaker: THE WOMAN
why_me.text: Because you kept coming back. Because some part of you believed love could outlive the ending.

choices.text: Did you ever love any version of me?

blade.speaker: THE WOMAN
blade.text: Then you remember more than the others did. I was afraid this time would be different.

choices.text: It is different. I'm still looking at you.
Tell me why you killed me.

every_one.speaker: THE WOMAN
every_one.text: Not the same you. The same hope, wearing a different life each time.

used.speaker: THE WOMAN
used.text: Yes. And every time I promised myself the next version would be the last.

ever_love.speaker: THE WOMAN
ever_love.text: I loved the person you became on the road. I feared the person who reached this room.

reason.speaker: THE WOMAN
reason.text: The chamber feeds on endings. If I refused it, the road took both of us. I chose to survive and called it fate.

choices.text: Then we destroy the chamber together.
You made your choice. Now I make mine.

break_cycle.speaker: THE SKELETON
break_cycle.text: There will be no next time.

truth_end.speaker: THE SKELETON
truth_end.text: No more songs. No more replacements. We end the machine that kept us both here.

mercy_end.speaker: THE SKELETON
mercy_end.text: I remember what you did. I also remember why I kept following. Neither memory owns me now.
